targets.name: Reiner Gamma
targets.says: Intuitive Machines' Nova-C lander will deliver four NASA CLPS science payloads to Reiner Gamma on the lunar nearside in 2026.

targets.name: Mons Mouton
targets.says: The Intuitive Machines Nova-C lander (IM-4) will deliver six NASA CLPS science payloads to Mons Mouton.

targets.name: Schrödinger basin
targets.says: A lunar lander to be determined will deliver three NASA CLPS payloads to Schrödinger Basin.
